introHtml: Gray shot glasses offer a versatile and modern alternative to standard clear or colored glassware. Their neutral tone pairs well with any logo or design, making them a popular choice for corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, and special events. Whether you prefer a matte or glossy finish, these glasses can be screen printed or engraved with your brand. Durable and stackable, custom gray shot glasses are a practical promotional item that recipients will actually use.
